name: Crowley North Charleston Terminal - North Charleston SC

fieldNotes.siteIdentification: 2075 Thompson Ave, North Charleston SC 29405 - Crowley Liner & Logistics' North Charleston terminal (RoRo / LoLo, breakbulk, project cargo, warehousing/distribution), confirmed via crowley.com/locations + Yelp/business listings. Sits on the Cooper River inside the former Charleston Naval Base, immediately adjacent to the SC Ports / Veterans Terminal breakbulk complex. The finger piers visible NE in satellite host laid-up Ready Reserve Force vessels. The geofence covers the Crowley pier-head office/terminal building, its parking, and the adjacent paved cargo lay-down area - NOT the entire Navy base.
fieldNotes.yardSpotsMeaning: trailerParkingCapacity here = CONTAINER / RoRo cargo lay-down + chassis/trailer ground slots on the paved aprons, NOT warehouse trailer-dock stalls. ~15 trailers/units visible in z19-z20; the large paved lay-down pads could hold ~120+ units/containers. Marine-terminal estimate, low confidence - lay-down area is shared port apron without painted stalls.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Marine terminal - essentially no warehouse-style dock bank. dockDoorCount reflects 1-2 loading positions on the small transit/terminal building. dockDoors band 0-10. Cargo moves via RoRo ramps and lift-on/lift-off at the pier, not truck docks.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View on Thompson Ave (pano ya_2rL1jthob0aiLt3saxA, 2024-11) shows a continuous chain-link perimeter fence with red-roofed warehouses behind it - a fenced, controlled port compound. The former Navy base / port operates a controlled access point on Thompson Ave. Set truckGate=true with guardShack=true (standard port gate) but flagged uncertain: the exact Crowley-specific gate vs the shared base gate is not individually resolved, and the booth itself is not directly imaged.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Controlled port-style entry implies a manned gate; flagged uncertain because the specific booth structure was not directly resolved in the imagery available.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Port access gate; 1 in / 1 out assumed for a secondary terminal entrance - counts approximate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: The former Charleston Navy Base and Veterans Terminal complex is rail-served (port rail spurs run through the base); rail lines are visible threading the terminal area. Set true at the complex level.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly resolved; common at ports but not confirmed - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense North Charleston / Charleston metro industrial waterfront - Urban.
